content.text:
I fixed the disappearing Close button in `src/lib/components/chat/UploadedFile.svelte`. I haven't run the app or any tests, so I haven't seen it in dark mode.

The Close button in the "Pasted Content" modal had `hover:text-gray-800` with no dark-mode variant. In dark theme the hover color is almost the same as the dark background, so the icon vanished.

I added `dark:text-gray-400 dark:hover:text-gray-200` to the button. This is the same pairing `Alternatives.svelte` already uses for its hover states.
